headline: Northern Arc Capital appoints Anuradha Rao as Non-Executive Director
hook: Board addition ahead at Northern Arc
summary: Northern Arc Capital Limited has announced the appointment of Mr. Anuradha Rao as a Non-Executive Director on its board, effective October 31, 2026. Board changes of this nature are standard corporate governance updates for listed financial entities. Indian retail investors tracking the company's leadership composition should note this upcoming addition.
why_it_matters: Routine board appointment with negligible immediate impact on stock price
